title: reckon-cloud-resource
description: A cloud resource: an object a cloud control plane manages, such as a bucket or a role. The STIX common properties come from the STIX 2.1 core schema, so this schema lists only the ones it constrains.

uid.description: The provider's unique id for the resource.

resource_type.description: The provider's type for the resource, such as AWS::S3::Bucket.

region.description: The region the resource is in.

zone.description: The zone the resource is in.

group.description: The resource group the resource is in.

namespace.description: The namespace the resource is in.

account_ref.description: The account the resource is in, for a resource identified by its name.
